verdict.rationale: Bland explicitly provides development/staging/production environments per agent, drafts that don't affect live calls, a testbed to re-run isolated interactions, and staged/canary rollout to test new versions against real traffic before full production commitment — all clearly separating sandbox/testing from production data. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that staging truly isolates data from production (only vendor docs cited) and no explicit mention of synthetic/test data isolation guarantees.
